feature: Offline baseline skills for native clients and read-only bundled skill access for MCP hosts

scope.native_clients: Bootstrap or the packaged installer prepares the 11 bundled skill dependencies only for the selected native client. Existing third-party skills, symbolic links and user modifications are preserved.
scope.mcp_hosts: arslanbek_list_skills and arslanbek_read_skill expose reviewed instruction resources independently of school collection consent. Applying instructions and running tools depend on host capabilities.
scope.offline_baseline: Core preparation uses the package's Python interpreter and requires no network, npm or Bash. External services and optional stack-specific skills are separate.
scope.optional_online_skills: Install exact requested skill names for the selected native agent. Claude Code plugins are restricted to Claude Code.
scope.format: Persistent chat and matching local HTML preferences remain enabled; explicit chat-only choices and existing instructions are preserved.
scope.deployment: Only the existing frontend service was deployed. Staged public files exclude private configuration. Pinned archive transport reconstructed and verified the original release archive bytes before build.
scope.billing: Railway reported PRO at publication time. No plan or billing settings were changed by the agent.
